in_sanskrit.name: Kabali
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Black
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kabali एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Kabali is derived from the Hindi word ‘kabal’ which means ‘black’. It is a powerful name that signifies strength, courage, and resilience. The name is often given to boys who are expected to lead with determination and bravery.
